newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus to manufacture modified TU-134 aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Belarus to manufacture modified TU-134 aircraft.

text.p: The former Soviet republic of Belarus plans to modify TU-134 jets to produce a more efficient version of the regional passenger plane, the chief executive of the Minsky Aviaremontny Zavod aircraft factory said on Wednesday.

Fyodor Ivanov told a news conference the new TU-134M model would be recycled from TU-134s, commonly used in former Soviet countries for short- and medium-haul flights, and would cost five times less than new airplanes.
"This will mean a brand-new type of jet in terms of fuel consumption, engine size, and interior," Ivanov said.
"The first jet will fly in May 1998. In five years we will build between 100 and 200 jets for the Russian and Belarussian markets," Ivanov said.
Ivanov said the new model would be built at the Minsk factory with cooperation from Russia's Tupolev design bureau.
